summary: Bridges locomotion state onto an Animator, so the movement components can stay animation-agnostic.
overview: The runtime bridge the locomotion components deliberately do not provide themselves. Both are animation-agnostic on purpose — UnityEvents only, no Animator reference — so a project with no animation set pays nothing. Add this on the same GameObject once a real Animator exists, and it forwards state into Animator parameters.
useCases: Connecting the character controller to an Animator without editing either.
Swapping animation sets by changing parameter names rather than code.
Removing animation entirely by deleting one component.

params.tuning: Must match the Animator parameter name exactly. A mismatch fails silently — Unity logs nothing for an unknown parameter name.
Leave unassigned and it looks on its own GameObject.

gotchas.title: Parameter names are strings, checked by nobody
gotchas.body: A typo, or renaming a parameter in the Animator, breaks the link with no error. If a character animates in the wrong state, check these names first.
